status: evidence frozen; public screenshot pairing verified; raw geometry and end-to-end model execution unverified

scope.intent: Bounded public TripoSG input/rawshape/painted-output provenance check, supplementary 3D research for a music-video platform.
scope.applied_methodology: Pin revision and LFS hashes; inspect actual PNG bytes and images; distinguish shared screenshot subject from proven same indexed geometry; separate static source evidence and publisher claims from measured execution.
non_goals: No browser or product UI interaction
No product, MD, registry or registration proposal mutation
No weights, dependencies, inference, credentials or real provider calls
No commercial Tripo cloud parity claim
No product ingest or republication of unresolved sample media

public_file_availability.observed: The pinned public model repository exposes seven sample PNGs and model/configuration/workflow files. No GLB, glTF, OBJ, PLY, STL, FBX, USD, USDZ or BLEND path is in its complete API sibling list.
public_file_availability.limit: This is limited to this public repository/revision, not proof that no author-owned raw artifact exists elsewhere.

published_chain.common_source: Same pinned modelcard links these PNGs; source input is author-generated imagery, not verified as a real photograph.

observed.actual_local_images_viewed_with: functions tools.view_image, original detail, all four files
observed.same_subject_visual_correspondence: All three main images depict a rounded retro robot with a chest rectangle/circle panel, hook hands and boots. Clay and painted PNGs share a three-quarter view and similar framing/crop.
observed.color_change: Clay PNG has uniformly gray surfaces. Painted PNG has dark material/paint variation, black eye recesses and joint/chest details. It is visibly darker than the silver input; no measured relighting equivalence.
observed.shape_limits: Large head/body/limb/chest forms correspond visually. Input small triangular nose and tiny fasteners/surface detail are not faithfully evidenced by the clay render. Top of head and one boot are cropped in the two 512px sample renders.
observed.turntable: Published four-panel raster shows front/right/back/left labels and a closed-looking smooth back. A raster cannot establish watertightness or topology.

author_claims.same_mesh: The card describes the painted example as the same robot/mesh after a paint stage.
author_claims.input_to_shape: Robot shape 15.2 MB GLB, seed 42; initial row says 30 seconds.
author_claims.rawshape_stage: Later same card calls robot img2mesh 15.2 MB, 845k faces, 18 seconds.
author_claims.painted_stage: 27.6 MB with baked base-color texture and approximately 24 additional minutes; author attributes most delay to a Python UV hole-filling loop.
author_claims.raw_render: Author describes Blender Workbench clay renders of raw GLB with no cleanup/retopology/texturing.
author_claims.hardware: Publisher states RTX 5090; not our hardware benchmark.

inferences.claim: A staged shape-then-paint workflow can explain why appearance changes while major silhouette appears similar.
inferences.limit: The redistributor does not publish the raw pair or a logged execution receipt; its exact paint model/versions and parameters are not established by these screenshots.

inferences.claim: This is a useful qualitative example of appearance improvement, not a controlled shape-quality or production latency benchmark.
inferences.limit: Different resolution, camera, lighting, crop and material conditions prevent a scored before/after comparison to the input or a different platform.

unverified: Actual raw GLB bytes, face count, sizes, watertightness and editable original scene
Same vertex/index geometry before and after paint
Exact input-byte hash received by both stages
Seeds, stage logs, run identifiers, hardware load, timing and measured cost
UV/texture map contents, material model and renderer settings
End-to-end generation reproducibility and commercial Tripo cloud parity

same_geometry_verification.status: not possible from published files at this revision
same_geometry_verification.reason: Only PNG evidence is public. PNG SHA equality checks publication integrity, not mesh identity.
same_geometry_verification.required_next_evidence: Obtain rights-cleared input plus raw and painted GLB with run receipt; decode POSITION and triangle-index accessors, compare canonical geometry and transforms, and explicitly account for UV-driven vertex duplication/reindexing. Separately inspect UV/material/texture data. File-level GLB hashes alone are not geometry hashes.

latency_status.conflict: Robot raw shape appears as both 30s and 18s in the same pinned card.
latency_status.decision: Retain both as conflicting author claims. Do not choose one as validated latency or use 24min as a platform SLA.

official_source_check.observed: Official demo constructs a TripoSG triangle mesh, can simplify it, exports GLB, then exposes a separate Apply Texture action. run_texture receives image, mesh_path and seed; MV-Adapter multi-view output and TexturePipeline are used for UV unwrapping/base texture synthesis.
limits: Source was downloaded as text and not executed.
Official demo source does not prove the community publisher used the identical paint implementation.
Official open model/demo does not establish architecture, quality, pricing or model identity of current commercial Tripo service.

platform_relevance.recommended_interpretation: Optional 3D asset enrichment can keep shape, paint, native scene placement/light/camera and final video render as distinct internal jobs with visible task outcomes; no photo or 3D requirement should be added to music-first creation.
platform_relevance.usable_now: Provenance schema and staged quality/evidence criteria only.
not_adopted: No architecture or UI feature changed
platform_relevance.next_needed: Rights-cleared matched GLB pair and actual internal import/edit/render round trip would be needed before accepting geometry preservation or a native 3D pipeline benchmark.

license_result: See licenses.json: official software MIT is observed; dependencies and sample media have separate/unresolved terms. Community bundle must not be promoted to unrestricted MIT product ingestion.
completion_basis: Completed the bounded public-file/provenance and visual review. No raw geometry or live model test is claimed complete. Follow-up requirements are explicit rather than silently removed.
